content.comment_body: Hello, I have another question about timers. Could you advise on how to set this parameter?
In [product_name], which function block are you referring to?
On-delay timer can be used with a reset command.
Alternatively, you can apply the relay function 'Retentive on-delay' with an inverted input.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are looking for advice on configuring timer functions in [company_name] products, particularly around using on-delay timers, reset commands, and retentive relay functionalities. There is some confusion about which function block to choose and how each parameter works. More user-friendly documentation and interface design for timer settings are needed.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect straightforward advice on selecting and setting up timer parameters, with clear explanations of function blocks and their operation.
